meta.title: Customizable Invoice Template: refused for a user without the AP Executive role
gaps: Sign in as a user without the AP Executive role and verify Customizable Invoice Template is refused or absent, then repeat as an AP Executive and verify it is available.
Navigate to and operate the Customizable Invoice Template feature, because no catalog step represents invoice template configuration or its permission outcome.
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: Sign in as a user without the AP Executive role and verify Customizable Invoice Template is refused or absent, then repeat as an AP Executive and verify it is available.; Navigate to and operate the Customizable Invoice Template feature, because no catalog step represents invoice template configuration or its permission outcome.

args.need: sign in as a non-AP Executive user and an AP Executive in the same tenant, open Customizable Invoice Template, and verify that the action is refused or absent for the first user and available for the AP Executive

steps.note: Role-specific sign-in and the Customizable Invoice Template workflow are not expressible by the catalog.
